brief:
Shehab Wire reported that Palestinians are commemorating the 14th anniversary of Operation Stones of Sijjil, the military campaign that erupted following the assassination of Hamas commander Ahmad al-Jaabari. The operation represents a pivotal moment in Palestinian resistance history and the broader conflict with Israeli occupation.

The operation was launched in response to al-Jaabari's targeted killing and marked a significant chapter in Palestinian armed struggle and resistance tactics against occupation forces.

title: Palestinian resistance marks anniversary of operation following Jaabari's killing
